originalTitle: Current Ebola outbreak worst ever in DR Congo, WHO says
title: Super Helpers Are Fighting a Tiny Germ in DR Congo!
content:
Hello, amazing kids of Africa! Your friendly news reporter here with a very important message from a beautiful country called the Democratic Republic of Congo, or DR Congo for short. Right now, some people there are getting sick from a tiny, tiny germ called Ebola. But don't worry, lots of grown-ups are working super hard to help everyone stay safe and healthy!

What is Ebola?

Ebola is a very small germ, so small you can't even see it! It's like a tiny, invisible monster that can make people feel very, very unwell. When someone has Ebola, they might get a fever, which means their body feels very hot. They might also have a tummy ache, feel very tired, or have other aches. **Did you know?** Ebola is named after a river in DR Congo where it was first found a long, long time ago! Ebola does *not* spread through the air like a normal cold. Instead, it spreads when you touch someone who is very sick with Ebola, or if you touch things they have used that have their sick body fluids on them. That's why washing hands with soap and water is super, super important to keep these tiny germs away!

Where is This Happening?

This special news is about a part of DR Congo. DR Congo is a very big country right in the middle of Africa. If you look at a map of Africa, you'll see it right there! It's a place with lots of amazing animals and wonderful, kind people. **Did you know?** DR Congo is famous for its thick rainforests and for being home to special animals like mountain gorillas and okapis, which are like stripey giraffes! It's a country full of natural wonders.

Why Are We Talking About This?

Sadly, this time, the Ebola germ has made many people sick in DR Congo. More than 1,500 people have become unwell, and sadly, some have died. This is a very, very big number, and it makes many people sad. In fact, this is the biggest time Ebola has made so many people sick in DR Congo ever. That's why grown-ups, like doctors, nurses, and other special helpers, are working extra, extra hard to stop the germ. They want to help everyone get better and make sure the germ doesn't spread to more people. There's a big team called the World Health Organization, or WHO (that's W-H-O), helping too! **Did you know?** The WHO is like a team of super-doctors and nurses from all over the world who help countries stay healthy and fight sicknesses like Ebola!

Super Helpers Are On The Job!

Lots of brave doctors, nurses, and health workers are in DR Congo right now. They are like superheroes without capes! They wear special protective suits that look a bit funny, but these suits keep them safe from the Ebola germ. These amazing helpers are doing so much! They are taking care of sick people, making sure they get the best possible help to feel better. They are also teaching everyone how to wash their hands properly and how to stay safe so the germ doesn't spread. **Did you know?** Washing your hands with soap and water for as long as it takes to sing "Happy Birthday" twice can wash away many, many germs! Try it next time! They also help tell people what to do if someone they know gets sick, so they can get help quickly. These helpers are making a big difference every single day, working together to fight this tiny germ.

Looking For A Special Shield: Vaccines and Treatments

You know how you sometimes get a tiny shot, or a 'jab', to stop you from getting sick with things like the flu? That's called a vaccine! It's like a special shield that teaches your body how to fight germs before you even get sick. Think of it as your body's own superhero training! Right now, scientists and doctors are working super hard to find a perfect vaccine and special medicines (which are called treatments) for Ebola. They want something that can stop people from getting sick and help people who are already sick get better. Some new medicines are being tested right now to see if they can help people who are already sick with Ebola. This is really hopeful news, and everyone is excited about finding something that works very well! **Did you know?** Scientists are like detectives who study tiny things to find out how they work and how to fix them! They spend many hours in special labs.

It Can Be Tricky to Stop

Stopping Ebola can be tricky for a few reasons. Sometimes, people live far apart, and it's hard for doctors to reach everyone quickly. Also, sometimes people are scared and don't know who to trust, so they might not go to the doctors right away. There are also times when there is fighting in some areas, which makes it even harder for the helpers to do their important work. But even with these challenges, everyone is trying their very best to help!

How Can Kids Help?

Even though you are kids, you can help too! You can be a superhero in your own way! * Always wash your hands with soap and water, especially before eating and after playing. Remember the "Happy Birthday" song! * If you ever feel sick, or if you see a friend who looks very unwell, tell a grown-up straight away. They will know what to do. * Be kind to everyone. Remember, we are all a team, and we help each other! Ebola is a serious germ, but we have many brave people fighting it. By working together, staying clean, and listening to grown-ups, we can help keep everyone in DR Congo and all of Africa safe and healthy. You are all amazing, and together, we can make a difference!
summary: Brave doctors and helpers are working hard to stop a tiny germ called Ebola from making people sick in DR Congo, and we can all help by keeping our hands clean and telling adults if we feel unwell.
whyMatters: This is important because we want everyone in Africa to be healthy and safe, and by understanding how germs like Ebola spread, we can help protect ourselves and our friends, and support the amazing people who are working to stop the sickness.

originalTitle: Ethiopian death row inmates desperate to escape execution in Saudi Arabia call the BBC
title: Friends From Ethiopia Need Help Far From Home!
content:
Hello, Friends!

Hi everyone! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, bringing you a story from our big, beautiful continent of Africa. We're going to talk about some friends from Ethiopia who are very, very far from home. It's a bit of a sad story, but it's important to understand and hope for them. Imagine you are far away from your mum, dad, brothers, and sisters. Imagine you are in a country you don't know very well. And imagine you are in big trouble. That's how many people from Ethiopia feel right now.

Where Are Our Friends From?

Our friends are from a country called Ethiopia. It's a wonderful country in East Africa, famous for its yummy coffee and ancient history! It's a place with lovely mountains, green valleys, and happy people. Did you know? Ethiopia is one of the oldest countries in the world! It's never been colonized, which means no other country has ever fully taken it over. Many of these friends come from a special part of Ethiopia called Tigray. Tigray is a region with its own unique culture and traditions. It's a place where many families live and work.

Where Are They Now?

These friends are not in Ethiopia right now. They are in a country far away, across a big sea. This country is called Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia is a big country in the Middle East, known for its deserts and big cities. Why did they go to Saudi Arabia? Well, many people from Ethiopia travel to other countries to find work. They want to earn money to send back home to help their families. They hope to make life better for everyone. Sometimes, things don't go as planned. Sometimes, people get into trouble when they are far from home, in a place that is very different from their own.

What Kind of Trouble Are They In?

These friends are in very big trouble. They are in prison in Saudi Arabia. This means they cannot leave and cannot go home. When people are in prison, they are sometimes called 'inmates'. They are very, very scared. They are facing a very, very big punishment. It's a punishment so big that they are afraid of what might happen next. They really, really want to go home to their families. Imagine how lonely that must feel! Imagine how much they miss their loved ones and the comfort of their own country, Ethiopia. They are far from everything they know and love. Did you know? Saudi Arabia is a very hot country, mostly covered by desert. It also has a lot of oil, which is used to make fuel for cars and many other things around the world.

Who Did They Call For Help?

When people are in trouble, they often try to find help. These friends did something very brave. They used a phone to call a very big news company. This company is called the BBC. What is the BBC? It's like a giant storytelling company! They have reporters all over the world. They tell us about things happening in different countries. When people have an important story to tell, they sometimes call the BBC. Our friends called the BBC from their prison cells. They wanted to tell their stories. They wanted the world to know they are there and they need help. They want to ask for someone to help them go back home safely. They are desperate, which means they really, really, *really* want something to happen. They are desperate to escape this big punishment and return to their families in Ethiopia. They dream of seeing their homes again.

Why is Their Story Important?

This story is important because it reminds us that people everywhere need kindness and understanding. These friends are far from home, sad, and scared. They miss their families so much. They are asking for help, and it's good that their voices are being heard. When we hear stories like this, it makes us think about how we can be kind to everyone, no matter where they are from. It makes us remember that everyone deserves to be safe and to be with their family. We hope that good people will hear their calls and find a way to help them return home to Ethiopia. We hope they find peace. Did you know? The BBC started telling stories almost 100 years ago! It's one of the oldest and biggest news companies in the world, sharing news with many people. Let's send our kind thoughts to our friends in Saudi Arabia. Let's hope they get the help they need to be safe and sound back in their home country, Ethiopia, with their loved ones. Maybe, with enough people caring, their wish will come true soon!
summary: Many people from Ethiopia are far from home in Saudi Arabia, in big trouble and scared, calling a news company called the BBC to ask for help to go back to their families.
whyMatters: This story matters because it shows us that people from Africa can be in trouble far from home and need help, reminding us to be kind and understand that everyone deserves to be safe and with their families.

originalTitle: Chelsea confirm Welbeck signing from Brighton
title: Big News! Chelsea Has a New Goal Scorer!
content:
Hello, Super Football Fans!

Hello, amazing kids of Africa! Are you ready for some super exciting news from the world of football? We know how much you love football here. You kick balls with your friends, you cheer for your favourite teams, and you dream of scoring big goals! Today, we have some special news about a very famous football team called Chelsea. Do you know Chelsea? They are a really big team that wears blue shirts. Many kids all over the world, especially here in Africa, love to watch them play!

Who is Chelsea?

Chelsea is a football team from a country called England. They play in a big league, which is like a super important competition where many teams play against each other to see who is the best. Chelsea has lots of players who are super fast and super good at kicking the ball. They play in a stadium full of cheering fans. Imagine thousands of people all shouting and clapping! It's very exciting. Chelsea wants to win lots of games and trophies, which are like big shiny cups you get for being the best team. Did you know? Chelsea has won many trophies over the years! They work very hard to be one of the top teams in the world.

Meet Danny Welbeck!

Guess what? Chelsea has a brand new player! His name is Danny Welbeck. Can you say Danny Welbeck? Good job! Danny is a football player, just like the ones you see on TV. Danny is a special kind of player called a "striker." What does a striker do? A striker's job is to score goals! They run very fast, dribble the ball past other players, and then kick it into the net. That's how teams win games! Did you know? Scoring a goal is one of the most exciting things in football! When the ball goes into the net, everyone cheers super loud!

What Does "Signing" Mean?

Our news says that Chelsea has "signed" Danny Welbeck. What does that mean? It's like when you choose a new friend to play with every day. Danny was playing for another team before, called Brighton. Brighton is also a good team, but now Danny is going to play for Chelsea instead. When a player "signs" with a new team, it means they agree to play for that team. They get a new blue shirt, they meet new teammates, and they start training in a new place. It's like getting a new school or a new home for your football boots! It's a big change for Danny, but it's also very exciting! He gets to play with new friends and try new things on the football field.

Why is This Good News for Chelsea?

This is very good news for Chelsea and all their fans, especially you! Why? Because Danny Welbeck is very good at scoring goals. If Chelsea has a player who can score lots of goals, it means they have a better chance to win their games! Imagine your favourite team suddenly getting a super new player who can help them win more! That's exactly what is happening for Chelsea. Danny will bring his speed, his skill, and his goal-scoring power to the team. Did you know? Teamwork is super important in football! Even if one player is very good, they need all their teammates to help them win.

Danny's Football Journey

Danny Welbeck has played for other big teams before, too. He has played football since he was a little boy, just like some of you might be doing now. He worked very hard, practised every day, and learned how to be a fantastic footballer. From playing with friends to playing in big stadiums, Danny's journey shows us that if you work hard and never give up, you can achieve your dreams. Now he is ready for his new adventure with Chelsea. He will wear the famous blue shirt and try his best to make the Chelsea fans happy by scoring many goals. We hope he scores lots of goals for Chelsea!

Football is Fun for Everyone!

Football is so much fun, isn't it? It teaches us about teamwork, about being strong, and about never giving up. When you watch Danny Welbeck play for Chelsea, remember that he worked hard to get where he is. We love football here in Africa. Many famous African footballers have played for big teams in Europe, too! They inspire many young boys and girls to pick up a ball and start playing. So, let's cheer for Chelsea and their new player, Danny Welbeck! Let's hope he has a super time scoring goals and helping his new team win. Keep loving football, kids, and keep kicking that ball!

What's Next for Danny?

Now that Danny has joined Chelsea, he will start training with his new friends. They will practice together, learn new plays, and get ready for their next big game. It takes time for new players to get used to a new team, but Danny is a professional and he will work hard. Soon, you will see him running on the pitch in his blue Chelsea jersey, ready to score those amazing goals. We are so excited to see him play! Did you know? Football players often train for many hours every day to stay fit and strong! Let's all welcome Danny Welbeck to Chelsea and wish him the best of luck! Hooray for football and hooray for new players!
summary: Chelsea, a famous football team, has just signed Danny Welbeck, a talented player who is very good at scoring goals, making their team stronger and more exciting to watch.
whyMatters: This is important because Danny Welbeck can help Chelsea win more games by scoring goals, which is exciting for all the fans who love to watch Chelsea play football.

originalTitle: The five dramatic days that shook Infantino and world football
title: A Big Chat About Football's Future!
content:
Hello Football Fans!

Hello, amazing football fans all across Africa! Your friendly news reporter is here to tell you a super interesting story. It's all about our favourite game, football! We all love to kick a ball, right? Whether it's in the dusty streets, on green fields, or just dreaming about scoring a goal, football makes us happy. Did you know? Football is played by more people in the world than any other sport! It brings so many smiles.

Meet Our Football Friend, Gianni!

Today, we're talking about a very important person named Gianni Infantino. He's like the big boss or the main coach of world football. His job is to make sure football is fair and fun for everyone, everywhere. He works for a big football family called FIFA. Gianni travels all over the world, even to Africa, to talk about football. He wants to see more kids like you playing and loving the game.

What is FIFA Anyway?

FIFA is like a super big team that helps organize football games for the whole world! Think of it as the biggest football club, but it has almost every country as its members. They help make the rules for football, so everyone plays the same way. They also help organize the biggest football party in the world – the FIFA World Cup! That's where teams from different countries play to find out who is the best. It’s super exciting! Did you know? There are over 200 countries and places that are part of the FIFA family! That's more countries than are in the United Nations!

A Big Idea for Big Football Games!

So, a little while ago, Gianni and the people at FIFA had a big idea. They wanted to make the really big football games, like the World Cup, even more special and exciting. To do this, they thought about getting some special grown-up friends, like big companies, to help. These friends could give money to help make the tournaments better. It's like when you want to have a really awesome birthday party, and your family helps you get decorations and yummy food. FIFA wanted to get help to make football even bigger and better for everyone.

Sharing and Helping Together

This idea meant that these 'special partners' could help FIFA. The money they gave could be used for lots of good things. Maybe to build new, safe football fields for kids in different countries. Or to buy new footballs and jerseys for young teams who don't have much. It was a way to make sure that more children could play football. And that the big games could be even more amazing for the fans watching. Did you know? Playing football helps you make new friends and learn how to work together as a team!

Why Did Everyone Talk So Much?

Now, here's the interesting part! When Gianni and FIFA shared this big idea, not everyone agreed. Some people thought it was a really good way to get more help and make football grow. They said, "Yes, let's get these partners!" But other people thought, "Hmm, maybe FIFA should do all these big games by themselves. Maybe it's better if they don't share with others." It was like when you and your friends can't decide what game to play. Everyone had a different idea, and they talked about it a lot. It was a very big and important discussion. Did you know? In football, it's very important to play fair and respect everyone, even if they are on the other team.

Gianni Listens and Changes the Plan!

So, what happened next? Gianni Infantino, the big boss, did something very important. He listened! He listened to all the different ideas from people all over the world. He heard what everyone thought, both the good things and the worries. After listening carefully for a few days, Gianni made a big decision. He said, "Okay, for now, we will not go ahead with this big plan. We will find another way to make football awesome and keep everyone happy." He changed his mind because he cared about what everyone was saying. This shows us that even the 'big boss' listens to others and can change his plans to do what's best for the football family.

Football is Still for Everyone!

Even though that one big plan changed, the most important thing is that football is still here for all of us! FIFA still works very hard to make sure everyone can play and enjoy the game. They help boys and girls in many, many countries, including our amazing continent of Africa. They want to make sure there are good coaches, safe places to play, and lots of football fun for every child. They know that football can teach you important things like teamwork, discipline, and never giving up. Did you know? The FIFA World Cup happens only once every four years! It's worth the wait!

Lots of Football Fun in Africa!

Here in Africa, football is in our hearts! FIFA helps African countries in many ways. They help build new places for children to practice. They help train grown-ups to be good coaches for young teams. They want to see more amazing African football stars shine brightly on the world stage! We have so many talented players here, and FIFA wants to support them. They want to make sure that football grows stronger and stronger in every village, town, and city across Africa. Did you know? Africa hosted the FIFA World Cup for the first time ever in 2010, in South Africa! It was a very proud moment for our continent.

Keep Playing and Smiling!

So, little football stars, the big news is that Gianni and FIFA are always trying to do their best for our game. Sometimes plans change, and that's okay! The most important thing is that football continues to bring us joy, friendship, and lots of exciting moments. Keep playing, keep smiling, and keep loving football! Until next time, this is your African kid-friendly reporter signing off!
summary: The big boss of world football, Gianni Infantino, listened to everyone's ideas and decided to change his plan about getting special partners to help with big football games, showing that FIFA wants to make football great for all kids.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows that even big leaders listen to what people think. FIFA wants to make sure football is fun and fair for all children, especially by making good choices about how to grow the game and help countries like ours in Africa.
